sourceNote: Starter guidance for prototyping. Verify each item against current official Macau collection guidance before public release.

sources.name: Macao SAR Government Environmental Protection Bureau (DSPA)

rules.label: Plastic packaging
rules.localGuidance: Only treat clean, empty plastic packaging as recyclable when it matches the current local collection guidance.

rules.label: Paper and cardboard
rules.localGuidance: Keep paper and cardboard dry and remove non-paper parts when required by the current local collection guidance.

rules.label: Metal packaging
rules.localGuidance: Empty and rinse metal packaging before following the current local collection guidance.

rules.label: Glass packaging
rules.localGuidance: Handle glass carefully and follow the current local collection guidance for glass packaging.

rules.label: General waste
rules.localGuidance: If the item cannot be matched to a local recyclable stream, do not place it in a recycling container.
